statements.impact_statement: Netty DNS codec vulnerability fixed in 4.1.133.Final / 4.2.13.Final. Liquibase is a database migration CLI tool that does not run a DNS server or expose any DNS-processing listener. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport. Netty's DNS codec is used internally for resolving outbound hostnames; no inbound DNS requests are accepted.
